title: RetestOutcome
description: The outcome of a retest: the check of a finding run again against a tree that is not the tree where it was found. `kind` is `commit` for a commit that the owner says fixes the finding, and `patch` for a candidate patch applied to `baseCommit`. The meaning is the inverse of verification: a check that matches its expectation means that the weakness is still present. `rung` says how the outcome was reached and travels with the outcome everywhere, so that an argued `fixed` never reads as an executed one.

targetCommit.description: The tree under test: the commit, or the base that the patch applies to.

baseCommit.description: The commit where the finding was first proved, when it is known.

patchSha256.description: SHA-256 of the unified diff, for the kind `patch`.

rung.description: `executed`: the check ran in a sandbox. `argued`: a model reasoned from the diff; nothing ran. `unrelated`: the diff does not touch the cited code. `inconclusive`: no rung decided.

booted.description: True when the application served requests while the check ran.

harness.description: The test runner of the repository, when it ran the check instead of a started application.

rationale.description: The reasoning of a rung that did not execute.

changedFiles.description: The paths that the diff touched.
